intro.en: Contracts, pay, rights and conflicts: the vocabulary of working life in Spain.

titulo.en: Working life from contract to strike

texto.en:
**Two ways of working.** **Por cuenta ajena**: you are an employee. **Por cuenta propia**: you are **autónomo**.

**The contract.** **Indefinido** or **fijo** (permanent), **temporal**, **de prácticas**, and, in the newspapers, **contrato basura**. It begins with **un periodo de prueba**. You work **a tiempo completo** or **a tiempo parcial**, with **jornada continua** or **jornada partida** (with a long lunch break).

**Pay.** **El sueldo** or **el salario**, written on **la nómina**. In Spain most workers get two **pagas extra**, in summer and at Christmas. Also **horas extra**, **dietas** (expenses) and **comisiones**. You and the company **cotizáis a la Seguridad Social**, which later pays your **pensión**.

**Moving up or out.** **Ascender** and **el ascenso**; **pedir un aumento**; **renovar** el contrato. **Despedir** and **el despido**, with **una indemnización**. Then you **estás en paro** and **cobras el paro**.

**Absence.** **Estar de baja** (ill), **la baja por maternidad** or **paternidad**, **pedir un día libre**, **un día de permiso**.

**Conflict.** **El sindicato** defends the workers and negotiates **el convenio** with the company. If there is no agreement, **la plantilla** may **ir a la huelga** or **estar en huelga**.

**The staff.** **La plantilla** is all the workers. **Reducir la plantilla** means cutting jobs.

frases.es: La plantilla de la fábrica, formada por unos trescientos trabajadores, lleva dos semanas en huelga.
frases.en: The factory's workforce, made up of some three hundred workers, has been on strike for two weeks.

frases.es: El conflicto empezó cuando la empresa anunció que no renovaría los contratos temporales.
frases.en: The dispute began when the company announced that it would not renew the temporary contracts.

frases.es: Según los sindicatos, la mitad de los empleados encadena contratos de tres meses desde hace años.
frases.en: According to the unions, half the employees have been going from one three-month contract to the next for years.

frases.es: Reclaman que se les haga un contrato indefinido y que se respete el convenio, que fija dos pagas extra.
frases.en: They are demanding to be given a permanent contract and for the agreement, which sets two extra payments, to be respected.

frases.es: La dirección responde que, de aceptar esas condiciones, tendría que despedir a cincuenta personas.
frases.en: The management replies that, if it accepted those conditions, it would have to dismiss fifty people.

frases.es: Ayer ofreció una indemnización mayor a quienes se vayan voluntariamente, pero la oferta fue rechazada.
frases.en: Yesterday it offered higher compensation to those who leave voluntarily, but the offer was rejected.

frases.es: Mientras no haya acuerdo, advierten los trabajadores, no volverá a funcionar ni una sola máquina.
frases.en: As long as there is no agreement, the workers warn, not a single machine will run again.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what started the strike?

The company would not renew temporary co.en: Anunció que no renovaría los contratos temporales.

The company cut the extra payments.en: The agreement sets them, and workers want it respected.

Fifty people were dismissed.en: That is only what management says would happen.

bloques.correcta: The company would not renew temporary contracts

pregunta.en: According to the text, what happened to the company's offer?
Complete: as long as there is no agreement…

bloques.frase: Mientras no ___ acuerdo, seguirá la huelga.

haya.en: Mientras as a condition about the future takes the subjunctive.

hay.en: With the indicative, mientras means while. Here it means as long as.

pregunta.en: Someone who works for themselves is…

interino.en: That is a temporary public employee.

bloques.frase: La han ascendido a jefa de sección.

texto.en: She has been promoted to head of section.
She has gone up to see the head of section.

explicacion.en: Ascender a alguien: to promote someone.

texto.en: She has been dismissed as head of section.

bloques.frase: Toda la plantilla está en huelga desde el lunes

traduccion.en: The whole workforce has been on strike since Monday.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a newspaper-style report on a labour dispute, giving the position of the workers and of the company.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Talk aloud about working conditions in your sector and what you would change.
